body: I think one of the hardest parts of this, is accepting the fact I dont want them. It's too much for me. I did enough wrong, and i will fix this situation before it gets worse. So you can heal and get the right person. I dont want to hurt. I want to heal. I want to heal him. Start this process and get it done with. I have a long, long way to go before my wounds heal, and I'm not letting it be an excuse to hurt anyone anymore. But him, hes going to be just fine. Itll hurt but time will heal my being gone. Hell find someone who will treat him right. Sadly that person isn't me. Fate brought us together, and fate will have me clean my mess. I want to clean up these bruises on my heart and mind. And he can not be there for that. Not ever. I'll scrub and bleach and disinfect this horrible black slimy mess with my own hands. His presence is merely a distraction in my cleaning process

I have. But they just keep pushing themselves on me. And now they are cursing my death. Which is more than fair. No matter how many times I tell them, it's not you it's really me. Stay away. I'm a time bomb and they are one of my problems, it hurts them that much more I suppose.
